Todo comenzó en 2014 cuando empezamos a: It all began in 2014, when we started specialising in the management of agricultural estates. That was when we saw how heavily farms depended on industrial-scale sales to remain profitable. Producers sold their harvests to factories or intermediaries: when yields and prices were good, the land was profitable; when production fell or sale prices — which the producer did not set — were lower, that profitability disappeared.
Pero ¿qué pasa en el campo? Que un año t: And that is the reality of farming: one year your land is profitable, and the next you can be losing money.
En 2017 decidimos buscar una alternativa: In 2017 we decided to look for an alternative to selling through wholesalers and launched our first online shop, focused on products we produced ourselves.
De esta manera podíamos decidir a qué pr: This allowed us to decide the selling price of our own harvests while removing a large part of the chain of intermediaries that significantly increased the final price paid by the customer.
Después de dos años remando a contracorr: After two years of pushing ahead with very little experience of selling online, the work began to pay off. The products were good; they simply needed to become better known.
Poco a poco, de boca a boca y sin perder: Little by little, through word of mouth and without losing our enthusiasm, customers began contacting us to thank us for the initiative. They were delighted with the products.
Y si esto funciona, ¿Por qué no replicar: And if this works, why not open the same opportunity to other producers?
nace de la necesidad de que exista un ac: The project grew from the need to bring producers and end customers closer together.
Nuestro objetivo es ayudar a otros agric: Our aim is to help other farmers, livestock breeders, beekeepers, olive mills and producers sell their products through our platform, reducing intermediaries who absorb part of the margin and increase the final price.
De esta manera también garantizamos la t: This also helps preserve traceability from the producer through to the end customer.
Damos valor al producto y ayudamos al pr: We give the product the value it deserves and help producers improve their returns through fair prices that they themselves decide.
